title: Signature Math Mapping — QR-Style Matrix Pattern
description: How the Signature bitstring reads as QR-Style Matrix Pattern (Visual codes). QR codes are 2D matrices of dark/light modules with finder patterns in three corners. This record demonstrates the matrix-pattern idea; it does not generate scannable QR codes.

fields.name: QR-Style Matrix Pattern
fields.system: QR codes are 2D matrices of dark/light modules with finder patterns in three corners. This record demonstrates the matrix-pattern idea; it does not generate scannable QR codes.
fields.mapping: Lay the 144 Signature bits into a 12x12 module matrix (the math grid itself, at module scale). Reserve the three corner 3x3 zones as finder-style anchors. An honest pattern demonstration of 2D bit layout — labeled as such.
apply: 1. Take the 144-bit Signature string as 12 rows of 12.
2. Draw each bit as one square module: dark for 1, light for 0.
3. Mark the three corner 3x3 zones as finder-style anchors.
4. Label 'matrix-pattern demonstration — not a scannable QR code'.
